visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair and rectangular glasses sits centered in the frame. He wears a professional e-sports jersey featuring black, white, and gold panels with the Flash Wolves logo and a Red Bull patch on the right chest. He maintains a stoic facial expression, resting his hands on his lap. The background consists of a brightly lit indoor space with a large window revealing a distant urban skyline under a clear sky. (2) The visual cuts to a digital screen capture of a mobile MOBA game. Colorful characters engage in combat on a green field. Bright yellow energy bursts and blue circular effects explode as abilities are triggered. Health bars and player tags such as 'FW YuXiang' are visible above characters. (3) The scene returns to the young man in the jersey. He continues to speak towards an off-camera interviewer, maintaining eye contact with the camera. His expression is calm and professional, with natural micro-movements of his head and eyes. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows in the room.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: APL 2025 · 賽後快訪. [Slogan]: 煜翔今天APL首勝心情如何. (2) [Subtitle]: 贏了就還是保持平常心. (3) [Subtitle]: 畢竟我們還有下一場比賽. (4) [Slogan]: 煜翔第一場 6:34 你玩卡芬妮. (5) [Slogan]: 在上路被三人包. (6) [Slogan]: 那你撐了十幾秒直到隊友來收割. (7) [Slogan]: 可以說一下當下溝通是什麼嗎. (8) [Subtitle]: 一開始我們在清下兵的時候. (9) [Subtitle]: 我就有大概提到. (10) [Subtitle]: 瑟斐斯感覺一直在繞我們. (11) [Subtitle]: 結果到那後面是真的來了. (12) [Subtitle]: 我就想說. (13) [Subtitle]: 也沒有退路了. (14) [Subtitle]: 就幫忙先打輸出. (15) [Subtitle]: 然後拖到隊友到. (16) [Slogan]: 你有感覺這幾把他們都在針對你嗎. (17) [Subtitle]: 其實還好. (18) [Subtitle]: 針對我也沒差. (19) [Subtitle]: 遊戲會贏就好. (20) [Subtitle]: 我死就算了. (21) [Subtitle]: 感謝各位粉絲的支持. (22) [Subtitle]: 下一場比賽我們會繼續加油.
